Metadata.Name: AutoNAV
Metadata.Description: Automated Design Coordination Plugin for Navisworks Manage

File.Name: AutoNAV.addin
File.Description: Plugin Manifest (must be in same folder as AutoNAV.dll)

Feature.Name: Function 1: Discipline Search Sets
Feature.Description: Creates hierarchical search sets organized by discipline

Feature.Name: Function 2: Element Property Search Sets
Feature.Description: Generates search sets based on element properties and categories

Feature.Name: Function 3: Custom Value-Based Search Sets
Feature.Description: Creates custom search sets from any property value

Feature.Name: Function 4: Automated Clash Test Generation
Feature.Description: Generates clash tests from search set combinations

Feature.Name: Function 5: Clash Result Grouping
Feature.Description: Groups clash results by discipline and category

Feature.Name: Function 6: Walls/Floors Grouping by Discipline
Feature.Description: Groups clash results into Walls and Floors groups scoped per discipline pair

Installation.Note: Both AutoNAV.dll and AutoNAV.addin must be in the same AutoNAV\ subfolder

Changes.Change: Single installer detects and installs to all versions simultaneously
Function 6 grouping fix: Walls/Floors per discipline pair
Integrated UI with tabbed interface for all 6 functions

InstallationInstructions.Step: Extract the AutoNAV_v3.0.0 folder to a known location
Right-click Install_AutoNAV.bat and select "Run as administrator"
Installer detects all Navisworks versions and installs to each

UninstallationInstructions.Step: Right-click Uninstall_AutoNAV.bat and select "Run as administrator"
Installer removes from all detected Navisworks versions
